title: Upgrade planner and version policy for dedicated customers
description:
What: `papyrus upgrade plan` lists and runs the index-bearing releases in order, one new index per table per deploy, with a verification step after each. Policy: Papyrus manages upgrades for dedicated customers; self-hosters are on their own; one version number (the engine's); deprecated options warn for two minors, then error. First real case: Distinctive-web (see its board).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A plan splits two index releases into two deploys
  Given a site two releases behind, each adding one index to the same table
  When the plan is made
  Then it lists two separate deploys
